reason: A local DeepSeek Harness plugin for coordinating independent Agent sessions through message delivery, session discovery, delivery receipts, and session navigation.

summaries.zh: 用于在同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程中的独立 Agent 会话之间查找目标、发送消息并查询投递状态的协作编排插件。
summaries.en: A collaboration and orchestration plugin for discovering local Agent sessions, delivering messages between them, and checking delivery status in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Lists eligible local agent sessions and their runtime status
Sends messages to other local agent sessions
Queues follow-up messages and can inject or steer running sessions
Resumes offline local sessions for message delivery
Provides session targeting and navigation UI features
